title: Pilot traffic rollforward and compatibility gates for control-plane versioning
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Build an automated, testable pilot-traffic rollforward for control-plane version upgrades in VPC/private deployments. This ticket implements Terraform module hooks, an upgrade controller that performs staged traffic promotion, and a set of telemetry-driven compatibility gates so we can safely advance control-plane versions without manual coordination across tenants.

Scope:
- Add version-tagged Terraform outputs and a small upgrade orchestration module that can be wired into customer stacks.
- Implement a pilot-instance promotion controller that shifts a configurable percentage of control-plane traffic to the new version (pilot -> ramp -> promote), with automatic rollback on gate failure.
- Define and implement health gates based on reconciliation-lag, API-success-rate, leader stability, KV-cache hit ratio, and per-tenant rollout error budget.
- Integrate with existing telemetry dashboards and alerting (Console route + Slack) and emit upgrade events for audit logs.
- Provide a Playbook (markdown) for SRE/solutions to run manual overrides and postmortems.

Out of scope: cross-region failover automation and tenant data migrations; those will be handled by follow-ups.

Success criteria:
- Terraform module publishes a declarative UpgradePlan object and can be applied idempotently.
- Pilot promotion can run end-to-end in staging with a 0-downtime rollback when gates fail.
- New telemetry gates detect regressions within 5 minutes of first degraded samples and trigger automatic rollback.
- Documentation + runbook available for customer-facing Solutions Engineers.

Risks and trade-offs:
- More aggressive roll percentages shorten rollout time but increase blast radius; default policy will be conservative (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%).
- Relying on aggregated metrics (e.g., API success rate) can mask single-tenant regressions; we add per-tenant sampling for higher-risk upgrades.
- Terraform hook approach keeps IAC first-class but requires careful version compatibility in module outputs; we add integration tests to prevent drift.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module publishes UpgradePlan resource and is covered by automated unit and integration tests
Staging run: pilot -> ramp -> promote workflow completes and logs each state transition
Telemetry gates trigger rollback on simulated regression within 5 minutes
Runbook and quick checklist published to Confluence and linked from the console upgrade UI

2026-03-09: Telemetry contract approved with Observability team (metrics list, alert thresholds). Added per-tenant sampling requirement to avoid noisy aggregates.
2026-03-11: PR #4678 opened with Terraform module and controller scaffolding (github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4678). Waiting on infra/CI reviewers (Miguel + Priya).

2026-03-12: Integrated initial health probes into staging; discovered leader-election instability under simulated load — added mitigation: staggered leader handoff and brief quiesce window in rollout controller.
review_feedback: PM review (Priya Desai): prefer conservative default roll percentages and explicit tenant opt-in for early pilots.
Security (Samir Patel): require KMS-wrapped tokens for controller to call customer-managed control-plane endpoints; added to security checklist.
Observability (Lena Müller): request to include 95th/99th percentile API latency and reconciliation-lag as individual gate metrics.
